say:1:1610818001:1.text: Transfiguration tests a mage's focus like nothing else. Many graduates still shudder at the mention of it.
say:1:1610818001:1.source_cn: 变形术对施术者的魔法精神力的要求非常高，许多已经毕业的...

say:2:1610818002:1.text: But I have to say, your skills are already well beyond your classmates. Impressive.
say:2:1610818002:1.source_cn: 不过你们现在的变形术水准已经远超同阶学生，我很满意。

say:3:1610818003:1.text: So I'll teach you something special: <style="highlight">Ancestral Sense</style>. Master this, and it's like gaining a second pair of ears... or a third eye.

say:7:1610818007:1.text: If you use Ancestral Sense while in <style="highlight">animal form</style>, you can detect spirits <style="highlight">within a certain range</style> that normal eyes can't see.

say:10:1610818008:1.text: Oh! I read about this in a journal! It's based on advanced theories of mental-energy tides, right?
say:10:1610818008:1.source_cn: 我想起来了，我在学术期刊里读到过，先祖感应涉及到了高深...

say:13:1610818009:1.text: Your theoretical knowledge is good, but don't forget practical application. Some of the best shapeshifters know theory but fail in execution.
say:13:1610818009:1.source_cn: 你的理论知识很扎实，但不要忘记实践，不懂理论的变形大师...

say:14:1610818010:1.text: True mastery means making magic instinctive—like a chameleon changing colors or a lizard becoming an owlbear!
say:14:1610818010:1.source_cn: 最高深的变形术就是把知识化作本能，就像变色龙会变色，蜥...

say:17:1610818011:1.text: Professor Hepler's transfiguration is second nature to him...
say:17:1610818011:1.source_cn: 赫普老师的变形术的确已经是本能了……
